title: 第十四章 招揽谈话
slug: 民国我包国维黄埔一期
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

早上的时候，校长和包国维讲了会儿话。

下午的时候和助手说道：“去叫蒋羡耘来校长室。”

校长拿出了一本杂志在看，上面有刊载了蒋羡耘写的几篇文章。

“报告。”

“进。”

“校长，学生蒋羡耘报道。”

“最近在做什么？”

“学习，训练。”

校长的眼线很多，对学员的情况尤其是对第一名的情况非常清楚：“可我听说你经常组织红党的人开会开展一些活动。你这是违反校规。”

“校长，学生羡耘以为每一个党派都有组织活动的权利，您是国党一员，不也组织自己的活动吗？”

这句话说的直白，说到点上了。

第一期学员，湖南籍的人很多，有不少还是农民讲习所的成员，加入了组织的人也有不少。

“知道我为什么不处罚你吗，孙先生跟我讲要我极力栽培你，我也是要这么做的。入学考试第一名，平时训练成绩也是第一名，你在黄埔学生中的威信最高。”

全校只有那个贺中韩能勉强掰掰腕子。至于拼刺刀那回让包国维赢了，不少人认为是包国维的运气好，因为蒋羡耘的木枪不知道怎么回事竟然断裂了，甚至校长也是这么认为的。校长虽然注意到了包国维，又同是浙江人，但在校长心里，包国维的分量可远远不及这个第一名。

又把桌上的那本杂志给拿了起来：“这本杂志上有你发表的几篇军事文章，我看了，写的非常好。”

文章能发表在杂志上，那可非常了不起，那么多读书人学者，谁不想自己的文章能得以发表，但很多人都没得这个资格。

包国维如果是自己写的文章，能不能上报纸发表也两说，但他用的是后世最为经典的两篇白话诗，还上过教科书的，这样的文章发表在报纸上就不是难事了。

“仰赖校长栽培。”

“我是要栽培你，脱离红党。只要你跟着我，必大有作为，平步青云，我很看好你。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In the morning, the principal talked to Bao Guowei for a while.

In the afternoon, I told my assistant, "Go and ask Jiang Xianyun to come to the principal's office."

The principal took out a magazine and read it, which contained several articles written by Jiang Xianyun.

"Report."

"Come in."

"Principal, student Jiang Xianyun reports."

"What are you doing lately?"

"Study, train."

The principal has a lot of spies, and he is very clear about the students' situation, especially the situation of the first place: "But I heard that you often organize meetings for people from the Red Party to carry out some activities. You are violating school rules."

"Principal, student Xianyun believes that every political party has the right to organize activities. As a member of the Kuomintang, don't you also organize your own activities?"

This sentence is straightforward and to the point.

There were many students from Hunan in the first batch of students, many of whom were members of the Farmer Training Institute, and many who had joined the organization.

"Do you know why I don't punish you? Mr. Sun told me that I should do my best to cultivate you, and I will do the same. You are ranked first in the entrance examination and your training results are also the first. You have the highest prestige among Huangpu students."

He Zhonghan is the only one in the whole school who can barely fight.As for Bao Guowei's victory in the bayonet fight, many people thought it was Bao Guowei's good luck because Jiang Xianyun's wooden gun broke for no apparent reason. Even the principal thought so.Although the principal noticed that Bao Guowei was also from Zhejiang, in the principal's heart, Bao Guowei's importance was far less than that of the first place.

He picked up the magazine on the table and said, "There are several military articles you published in this magazine. I read them and they were very good."

It is very remarkable if an article can be published in a magazine. With so many scholars and scholars, who would not want their article to be published, but many people do not have this qualification.

If Bao Guowei had written his own article, it is unclear whether it could be published in a newspaper. However, he used two of the most classic vernacular poems of later generations, and they have been published in textbooks. It is not difficult for such an article to be published in a newspaper.

"Rely on the principal's cultivation."

"I want to cultivate you and break away from the Red Party. As long as you follow me, you will make great achievements and rise to success. I am very optimistic about you."
